title: Whole-genome CRISPR screening identifies genetic manipulations to reduce immune rejection of stem cell-derived islets
model: hESC-derived SC-islet grafts in NSG-MHC-null mice, Brunello genome-wide knockout library
contrast: hPi (PBMC-injected) vs control grafts, week 10 (5 vs 6 mice), control-normalized
paper_method: Per-gene negative-binomial mixed model (glmer.nb), KO x PBMC interaction LRT against non-targeting guides
paper_calls: 150 enriched and 253 depleted genes at FDR 0.10; CXCL10 top enriched (validated)
barcs_calls: 1 gene at FDR 0.10 (PPP6C, depleted); 0 against the control null
named_hits: 0/8 at FDR 0.10 (CXCL10 rank 1181, STAT1 51; B2M/HLA/TAP/JAK unranked)
verdict: Gene scores track the paper (Spearman 0.89) but BARCS calls almost nothing: the immune-evasion hits like CXCL10 depend on a mixed model pooling mouse/guide variance plus an expression filter, and the large between-animal spread leaves them short of FDR in BARCS's per-guide test.
